name: QMugs: Quantum Mechanical Properties of Drug-like Molecules
description: QMugs is a quantum chemistry dataset comprising 665,911 biologically active and drug-like molecules extracted from ChEMBL. Developed at ETH Zurich, each molecule includes up to three distinct 3D conformers (1,992,984 total conformers) computed at the semi-empirical GFN2-xTB and quantum-mechanical DFT (ωB97X-D/def2-SVP) levels of theory, providing comprehensive molecular geometries, wave functions, Mulliken atomic charges, orbital energies, and dipole moments for molecular machine learning.

verification.notes: Verified against Scientific Data 2022 publication (DOI: 10.1038/s41597-022-01390-7). The primary corpus contains exactly 665,911 molecules across 1,992,984 quantum-mechanically optimized conformers.

size.notes: SDF files and CSV property summary tables.

citation.paper_title: QMugs, quantum mechanical properties of drug-like molecules
